$comment: B1.5c held-out queries (30, IDs H01-H30). Independent of the frozen B1.5a/B1.5b 60 queries: different file, different ids, different content slice, its own annotates.sha256 binding. Frozen before the measurement run; after the run the rules must not be changed to fit failures (plan §8.5).

quota.note: Intent figures include the four multi_slot cases (they keep their filter_catalog / similar_movies intent and are counted again in 'multi_slot'); the 26 base cases + 4 multi_slot = 30.
